defects.rationale: filename is interpolated directly into an os.system shell string, so a filename containing shell metacharacters (e.g. '; rm -rf /') executes arbitrary commands.
The os.system return code is returned without being checked, so a failed conversion is indistinguishable from success to callers that ignore the value.
